rebuiltFromArabic.why: the 2026-10-22 CATT run had drifted on these matns, leaving misaligned marks («صٍدوَرهٍم», «فْنَعَمْ»)

fixedForms.honorific: every «صلى الله عليه وسلم» left bare or mis-marked (e.g. «صَلَّى اللَّهِ») is written «صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ»
fixedForms.tatweel: removed from hadith 830's reading text (verse lines «مصرعــي», «أوصـــال»)
fixedForms.leftAsIs: «او» (2) and «اي» (1): marking them would need a hamza or an alef vowel
